title: Flip Your Producer-to-Consumer Ratio for 30 Days
alt_title_1: The 1 Ratio Separating Asset Owners From Scroll Addicts
alt_title_2: MJ DeMarco's Producer Shift: Create Before You Consume
description_hook: The average adult consumes 4+ hours of algorithmic feeds every day and produces 0 minutes of scalable intellectual property. This video covers the 30-day Create-Before-You-Scroll protocol inspired by 'The Millionaire Fastlane'.

affiliate_cta.offer_name: 30-Day Producer Sprint Tracker + Fastlane Book List
affiliate_cta.pinned_comment: What is ONE asset brick you are committing to build every morning before opening social feeds this month? 👇 Grab our 30-Day Producer Sprint Tracker here: https://kenvh0010-lang.github.io/admin/bio/

scenes.headline: 4 Hours Consuming vs 0 Minutes Owning
scenes.stat_label: DAILY FEED SCROLLING VS 0 MINS ASSET BUILDING
bullets: Attention is currency spent on someone else's platform
Zero production means zero compounding equity
scenes.narration: Many adults spend hours a day consuming algorithmic feeds, and zero minutes producing anything they own.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin rule of thumb (advice, not a study)

scenes.headline: The Millionaire Fastlane Identity Shift
scenes.left_body: Scrolls passively, buys every trend, rents out hours
scenes.right_body: Reverse-engineers hooks, ships tools, owns distribution
scenes.narration: In The Millionaire Fastlane, author M. J. DeMarco highlights the invisible divide: consumers experience the economy as buyers and spectators, while producers study every product, hook, and system as builders.

scenes.headline: 60 Morning Minutes = 365 Asset Hours a Year
scenes.stat_label: ANNUAL OUTPUT FROM ONE DAILY CREATION HOUR
bullets: Equals 9 full 40-hour workweeks of pure creation
Enough to launch software, templates, or a media catalog
scenes.narration: Every hour you scroll transfers your attention equity into someone else's business asset. Flipping just sixty morning minutes into creation compounds into three hundred sixty-five hours a year.

scenes.headline: The 30-Day Create-Before-You-Scroll Rule
scenes.stat_label: SHIP 1 ASSET BRICK BEFORE OPENING ANY FEED
scenes.stat_subtext: Write 300 words • Code 1 feature • Outline 1 video daily
scenes.narration: Test the Create-Before-You-Scroll rule for the next thirty days: lock entertainment feeds every morning until you write, code, design, or record one tangible brick.

scenes.headline: Move to the Producer Side of the Glass
scenes.stat_label: EARN EVERY SCROLL MINUTE WITH SHIPPED CRAFT
bullets: Protect your sharpest morning energy for ownership
Consume intentionally only after daily output is live
scenes.narration: Cashflow and leverage always flow toward the side of the screen that ships value.
scenes.source: Mind & Margin rule of thumb (advice, not a study)
